name: Epson L3210

maintenance.title: Head cleaning
maintenance.how: Hold the ink (droplet) button on the printer for 3 seconds.

maintenance.title: Nozzle check
maintenance.how: Print the nozzle pattern below. Gaps or missing colour bars mean a clean is needed.

maintenance.title: Ink refill
maintenance.how: EcoTank: refill only with the matching Epson bottle colour, then press the ink button once.

notes: Epson lists borderless for 4x6 in photo paper; A4 borderless may not exist in every driver version.
